say:1:1130525001:1.text: Haven't seen them for a long time!
say:1:1130525001:1.source_cn: 俺已经很久没见过他们了！
say:1:1130525001:1.male: Haven't seen them for a long time!
say:1:1130525001:1.female: Haven't seen them for a long time!

say:2:1130525002:1.text: It's great news to hear the leader of the Claws kicked the bucket.
say:2:1130525002:1.source_cn: 听说流沙之爪头目被打倒了，真是大快人心。
say:2:1130525002:1.male: It's great news to hear the leader of the Claws kicked the bucket.
say:2:1130525002:1.female: It's great news to hear the leader of the Claws kicked the bucket.

say:3:1130525003:1.text: If they weren't so damn sneaky I'd have no reason to fear them!
say:3:1130525003:1.source_cn: 如果不是总搞偷袭，俺才不怕他们！
say:3:1130525003:1.male: If they weren't so damn sneaky I'd have no reason to fear them!
say:3:1130525003:1.female: If they weren't so damn sneaky I'd have no reason to fear them!
